name: summonerkit
description: A privacy-first Windows companion for League of Legends.
author: Mohamed Magdy

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/contracts && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/core && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/remote && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/ui && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/client-tab && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/mobile && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/relay && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/data-publisher && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/remote && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/client-tab && npm run package --workspace @summonerkit/desktop
scripts.make: npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/remote && npm run build --workspace @summonerkit/client-tab && npm run make --workspace @summonerkit/desktop
